posts.title: Boox Go 7 Review
posts.description: I've been using my new Boox Go 7 for a couple weeks now, and I'm loving it so far. I decided to go with the Boox because it runs Android, which allows me to run any bookstore app or use my own files. I can run Kindle, Kobo, Readwise, and more. posts.title: Re: The difference between rest and idleness
posts.description: The difference between rest and idleness The difference is not one of activity.
